title: The lowest-calorie fish

seo.title: Lowest-calorie fish: ranking per 100 grams
seo.meta_description: Raw flatfish, haddock, cod and other lean fish provide roughly 70–95 calories per 100 g, substantially less than oily fish such as salmon or mackerel.
seo.search_intent: Compare fish with the fewest calories per 100 g under matched raw conditions.

excerpt: Lean white fish dominate the low-calorie end. USDA references put raw flatfish such as flounder/sole at about 70 calories per 100 g, haddock at 74 and Atlantic cod around 82. Preparation can change the final calorie density more than a few places in the ranking.
content_html:
A calorie ranking only makes sense when the fish are compared in the same state. These values use raw fish per 100 g, without oil, breading or sauce.

Fish at the low-calorie end

Raw fishApprox. calories/100 gApprox. fat
Flatfish (flounder/sole species)~70~1.9 g
Haddock~74~0.5 g
Monkfish~75–80~0.7 g
Atlantic cod~82~0.7 g
Hake~80–90~1–2 g
Pollock~90–95~1 g

The USDA raw flatfish reference provides about 70 calories and 12.4 g protein per 100 g; raw haddock provides about 74 calories and 16.3 g protein.

Fat explains much of the gap

Fat contributes about 9 calories per gram. A fish with 1 g fat receives about 9 calories from fat; one with 12 g receives roughly 108 calories from fat alone. Oily fish therefore tend to be substantially more energy-dense.

Lowest calorie does not mean nutritionally best

Salmon, sardines and mackerel generally contain more calories but also much more EPA and DHA. A cod-versus-salmon choice can depend on whether the priority is low energy density or marine omega-3 intake.

Cooking can reshuffle the numbers

Adding 15 g oil can contribute up to about 135 calories if all of it remains in the food. Even dry cooking concentrates calories per 100 g as water evaporates.

Bottom line

Lean fish commonly sit around 70–95 calories per 100 g raw. Compare species in the same state and account for added fat before deciding which dish is actually lower in calories.

faq.question: What fish has the fewest calories?
faq.answer: USDA raw flatfish such as flounder/sole are about 70 calories per 100 g; haddock is about 74.

faq.question: Is cod low in calories?
faq.answer: Yes. Raw Atlantic cod is roughly 82 calories per 100 g in USDA references.

faq.question: Is lower-calorie fish always healthier?
faq.answer: No. Oily fish contain more calories but usually provide substantially more EPA and DHA omega-3.
